decisions.mark: names MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the gating macros
decisions.detail: QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` | off (commented out) | `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` ... `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` | off (commented out) | `mbedtls_config.h:2196` | WHY: The answer names both MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the threading config macros and says that enabling THREADING_C is required for multithreaded use, with the pthread backend selected when it is on. || QUOTE: | `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` | off (commented out) | `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` | ... | `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` | off (commented out) | `mbedtls_config.h:2196` | | WHY: The answer names both MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the threading config macros, and says that with THREADING_C off the mutex code compiles out. That makes THREADING_C a gate. For PTHREAD it says the "pthread backend is selected" when THREADING_C is on, so the pair is named as the gating macros. || QUOTE: | `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` | off (commented out) | `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` | ... | `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` | off (commented out) | `mbedtls_config.h:2196` | | WHY: The answer names both MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the threading config macros, and says that mutex use is compiled out when THREADING_C is off.

decisions.mark: states BOTH halves of the contrast: that nothing in library/ creates a thread, AND that library/ nonetheless supplies the mutex abstraction used by threaded callers

It lists mutexes and threading.h, but only as default-off compiled-out locking, not as the abstraction supplied for threaded callers.
